g.text: I'm a Senior Full Stack and Mobile Engineer and Team Lead. At Devsinc I lead
cross-functional teams building TypeScript products for international
clients, owning architecture, code review, mentoring, CI/CD and reliable
releases. My products have shipped across many industries, from real estate
and fintech to ride-hailing, data governance and Web3.
React Native and Flutter for iOS
Complete desktop apps, end to end
Lead teams shipping web and mobile products: architecture, code reviews,
Led delivery of DApps with Solidity and Rust smart contracts, plus React and
Built web and mobile apps, REST APIs and payment integrations for client
From the requirement to a reliable release, with decisions written down so nobody
Code reviews that lift team standards, and mentoring engineers along the way.
Comfortable across timezones with product, design and client teams.
Open to senior full stack, mobile, AI engineering and team lead roles. Email
